architecture: MarkerNet: ResNet-34 (ImageNet) + U-Net decoder to stride 2, CenterNet heatmap + offset + shape class + associative embedding + marker size + plot/legend region (v2)
post_processing_chosen_on: validation split of the training data + stress validation set (scripts/train/marker_detector/tune_post.py)
calibration: automatic: frame rules + Tesseract tick OCR (adapter/auto_axis_calibration.py)
seconds_note: detector forward on mps + post-processing; noaxis adds the automatic calibration (Tesseract)
